commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
echo "Running mypy type checking..."
mypy src/

# If mypy failed, block the commit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Type-checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Type-checking passed."
EOF
echo "Running pre-commit hook manually to test..." && .git/hooks/pre-commit
git add src/py.typed .git/hooks/pre-commit && git commit -m "release: v1.0.0"
git add src/py.typed && git commit -m "test" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "# Test comment" >> src/__init__.py && git add src/__init__.py && git commit -m "test hook"
